stories.headline: This Trade School Stock Is Up 135%. Here’s Why a Fund Still Bought 459,000 Shares
stories.body: Key PointsNicholas Investment Partners bought 459,509 shares of Lincoln Educational Services Corporation in the first quarter; the estimated transaction value was $14.46 million (based on quarterly average prices).

stories.headline: FPC Says Clear Dispute Rules Pave Way for Trusted Instant Payments
stories.body: A clear and consistent dispute resolution process is essential to building trust and promoting the growth of instant payments, according to two contributors to a report released Friday (May 15) by the U.S. Faster Payments Council (FPC). The report, “Instant Payments Fraud Dispute Resolution: Guidance Principles for the U.S.,” addresses the unique challenges of fraud dispute

stories.headline: Newsom taps Chopra to lead new California oversight agency
stories.body: In a move seen to bolster his 2028 presidential run, California Governor Gavin Newsom named Rohit Chopra, the former director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, to lead a new oversight agency; a Pine Bluff, Arkansas, bank employee was sentenced to 36 months in federal prison for bank theft; a Fairfax, Virginia, security administrator has been charged with allegedly stealing more than $6.6 million from his employer; and more in this week's banking news roundup.
